Record Class CachedInnerClass

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
uno.anahata.asi.nb.tools.project.components.CachedInnerClass
Record Components:
fqn - The fully qualified name of the nested type (e.g. "com.foo.Bar$Inner").
kind - The Java element kind (e.g. ElementKind.CLASS, ElementKind.INTERFACE, ElementKind.RECORD).
supertypes - The formatted supertypes string (e.g. "implements Serializable"), or null if none.
javadocSummary - The sanitized first sentence of the class-level Javadoc summary, or null if none.
children - Recursive list of nested member types declared within this inner class.
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public record CachedInnerClass(String fqn, ElementKind kind, String supertypes, String javadocSummary, List<CachedInnerClass> children) extends Record implements Serializable
Immutable descriptor representing a cached inner or nested class within a Java source file.

Preserves the structural hierarchy, element kind, supertypes, and Javadoc summary of nested types across turns without requiring re-parsing of the AST symbol table.

Author:
Anahata

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
